description: Read the WHO ICD-10/ICD-11 mapping rows for one code, verbatim: to_icd11 for a Polish ICD-10 code, to_icd10 for an ICD-11 code. WHO states no match type, its ICD-10 side is the 2019 edition, not Polish 2008, and ICD-11 is not in force in Poland: treat a row as a lead and confirm the target with get_code.

code.description: An ICD-10 PL code for to_icd11, an ICD-11 code for to_icd10.
